data.row_id_column: Column name used as row id (default: first column).

plot_mode.show_value: Show numeric value text inside each cell (true/false).
plot_mode.show_row_stats: Show row summary statistic on the right margin (true/false).
plot_mode.show_col_stats: Show column summary statistic on the bottom margin (true/false).
plot_mode.stat_function: Summary function for margins: sum, mean, median, max, min, sd, var.
plot_mode.use_gradient: Map tile fill color to value via a gradient/colorbar (true/false). When false, tiles use a fixed fill_color.

typography.x_axis_text_angle: X tick label angle in degrees.

colors.fill_color: Tile background fill when use_gradient is false.
colors.text_color: In-cell value text color and axis text color.
colors.stat_color: Alias of stat_text_color for margin stat text.
colors.gradient_low: Low end of the value gradient (when use_gradient is true).
colors.gradient_high: High end of the value gradient (when use_gradient is true).
colors.palette: Named RColorBrewer palette used for the gradient instead of gradient_low/high (e.g. Blues, Reds, Viridis).

annotations.highlight_rows: Row ids to outline with highlight_color.
annotations.highlight_columns: Column/sample names to outline with highlight_color.

legends.legend_position: right, left, bottom, top, or none.
legends.legend_name: Legend title for the size (and fill) legend.
legends.colorbar_width: Colorbar width in cm (when use_gradient is true).
legends.colorbar_height: Colorbar height in cm (when use_gradient is true).
